content:
Apple today released a fun new ad promoting the brand-new Mac mini with the M6 chip. Apple also subsequently shared a short behind-the-scenes video showing off the (significant) effort that went into making the ad. Check it out below.

"We had to hand carve and create everything"

Apple's @helloapple Instagram account today posted a short Instagram Reels showing some of the process behind making the new Mac mini (M6 version) ad.

In the video (shared by MacMagazine), animators Justin Rasch and Scott Daros, along with art director Josh Mahan, walk through the sketches, props, sculptures, techniques and materials used in production, as well as time-lapse and behind-the-scenes clips of the stop-motion animation, revealing how several of the ad's animations came to life.

While this ad doesn't quite reach the same heights as Apple's TikTok promotional campaign for the entry-level MacBook Neo laptop, it's still pretty fun—especially after you've seen how it was made.
